tyr_build: CMake Release; TYR_BUILD_EXECUTABLES=ON; TYR_ENABLE_LTO=OFF; GCC/G++ 16.2.1; pyyggdrasil 0.2.5; pypddl 1.2.1
algorithm: lifted GBFS lazy + RPG-FF, one Datalog thread and one search worker, unit heuristic/search costs, default preferred actions
command: gbfs_lazy -D DOMAIN -P PROBLEM -O PLAN -N 1 -M 1 -H rpg_ff --heuristic-cost-type unit --search-cost-type unit -V 0
timing: Full-process wall time; separate session after folplan/Powerlifted runs; no concurrent build
